archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: Medication Reconciliation Module
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
A Medication Reconciliation Module is a specialized functional component embedded within an electronic health record system that provides the user interface and logic engine required to compare, cross-reference, and update a patient's active medication lists.
Its purpose is to give frontline clinicians a clear, side-by-side visual workspace to seamlessly merge pre-admission medications with new clinical orders, drastically reducing manual transcription mistakes during data entry.
Example: An emergency department nurse opens this module during intake to view a patient's pharmacy-sourced medication history right next to the active hospital chart, clicking to instantly import the correct home dosages with a single action.
